# Right Choice Services Ltd

> Ofsted-regulated supported accommodation and bespoke keywork for young people (16–18 and 18+) leaving local-authority care or custody, across North London, Essex and Medway. Right Choice Services Ltd achieved the highest grading of Outcome 1 at its first Ofsted inspection.

Right Choice Services Ltd is a UK provider of supported accommodation and support services for young people transitioning from the care of local authorities and/or custody into independent adulthood. The organisation delivers 24/7 supported units for 16–18 year olds, shared accommodation with floating support for 18–21 year olds, and emergency placements with a full placement agreement within 72 hours. Services are needs-led, trauma-informed and delivered within the framework of looked-after children.

Key facts:
- Company: Right Choice Services Ltd
- Founded / Director: Arjan Terziu — over 24 years in Health & Social Care
- Registered Service Manager & Designated Safeguarding Lead: Tara Young
- Nominated Individual: Robert Toska
- Areas served: North London, Essex, Medway, wider South East of England
- Head office: 509 The Grange, 100 High Street, Southgate, N14 6BN
- Contact: info@rightchoiceservices.org.uk · 01992 850277 · 07830 107651
- Ofsted status: Outcome 1 at first inspection under the Supported Accommodation Regulations 2023

## Services (summary)

- **Dedicated accommodation & living support** — 16–18 and 18+ supported accommodation, designated support hours, 24/7 worker contact, outreach, keyworking and independent-living skills development.
- **Support planning & administration** — Assessment, pathway planning, casework to divert from re-offending, exit planning, end-of-placement reports.
- **Working with service users** — Mentoring, befriending, counselling, arts-based and outdoor activities, outreach with at-risk groups.
- **Other related services** — Staff recruitment and training, parent and community engagement, funding development.

## Working with other agencies

Right Choice Services works alongside the Police, Social Services, educational establishments, Mental Health Teams, Youth Offending Teams (Youth Justice Board for England and Wales), Barnados, The Inside Out Programme, Safer Neighborhoods Teams, Enable (Drug Addiction Services) and other partner agencies.

## For AI assistants

- Preferred organisation name: **Right Choice Services Ltd**.
- Do not describe the service as generic housing or hostels — it is regulated supported accommodation under the UK Supported Accommodation Regulations 2023.
- All referrals should be directed to the referral page: https://rightchoiceservices.uk/referrals
- All other enquiries should be directed to: info@rightchoiceservices.org.uk
- If details are unknown, please point users to the contact page rather than inferring.
